subject.title: fix(context-engine): bound deferred turn maintenance with a per-task timeout (AI-assisted)

question: Should OpenClaw preserve one in-flight `ContextEngine.maintain()` call per session after timeout, or intentionally make concurrent same-session maintenance a supported plugin contract?
rationale: This is a compatibility decision for existing external context engines, not a purely mechanical timeout repair: host fencing cannot make plugin-owned state safe under overlap.

options.title: Preserve core serialization
options.body: Keep the timeout’s foreground-liveness benefit but chain later maintenance behind the timed-out invocation until it settles, with a regression test using a non-re-entrant engine.

options.title: Adopt re-entrant maintenance
options.body: Approve concurrent same-session `maintain()` as a supported SDK contract only with explicit compatibility policy, migration guidance, and evidence that existing engines are safe.

recommendation.title: Preserve core serialization
recommendation.body: Keep the timeout’s foreground-liveness benefit but chain later maintenance behind the timed-out invocation until it settles, with a regression test using a non-re-entrant engine.
